item.title: [Repost] Students Spouting Internet Trash Talk Are 'Driving Shenzhen Teachers Crazy'
item.author: kuqilin@outlook.com (Kuqilin)
item.description:
[Repost] Students Spouting Internet Trash Talk Are 'Driving Shenzhen Teachers Crazy'

Author: Kuqilin(kuqilin@outlook.com)

Shenzhen junior high students are steeped in internet trash talk and profanity. Frontline teachers have limited disciplinary powers, and some parents are uncooperative or even file complaints, leaving education in a helpless predicament.

Published on 2026-07-17 at Kuqilin's Blog, last modified on 2026-07-17
